rationale: Shift the fp16 export budget toward recurrent-tail value matrices, which are reused during reverse-tail recurrence and have been a stronger local signal than broad projection keeps. This makes a real byte-allocation change while staying compact: reduce generic tail projection fp16 retention from 2 blocks to 1 block, add an explicit recurrent-tail c_v keep set, and remove the old special-case last-block c_v keep that was less aligned with the recurrence path.
title: Recurrent Tail Value-Path FP16 Budget Swap
